Sanfrecce Hiroshima vs Gangwon: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the AFC Champions League Elite group stage match, as Japan's Sanfrecce Hiroshima hosts South Korean club Gangwon FC. This is a classic clash of football philosophies – the tactically astute Japanese style versus the athletic Korean approach.

Kick-off: November 4, 2025, 10:00 UTC (13:00 MSK) Stadium: Edion Peace Wing Hiroshima, Hiroshima Competition: AFC Champions League Elite

Sanfrecce Hiroshima vs Gangwon: Match Preview

Sanfrecce Hiroshima, one of Japan's most consistent clubs, enters the match as the favorite due to their Champions League experience and home-field advantage. For the 'Viola,' a victory in this match is a crucial step towards advancing from the group. Gangwon, one of the surprise packages of the Korean K-League, will try to put up a fight and prove their success is no fluke. However, an away trip to Japan is traditionally a very tough challenge for Korean teams.

Team Form and Analysis

Sanfrecce Hiroshima (Japan)

The Japanese club, under its manager, is known for its tactical flexibility and discipline, often employing a formation with three central defenders. The team focuses on ball possession and quick combinations. At their new Edion Peace Wing stadium, Sanfrecce plays with particular inspiration and will aim to dominate from the first minute.

Gangwon (South Korea)

The Korean club is known for its athletic and physical style of play. Gangwon relies on high pressing and quick transitions from defense to attack. The team features several strong foreign players who lead the side. The main task for the visitors will be to withstand the initial onslaught and impose their own game on the opponent.

Head-to-Head Statistics

This will be the first official meeting between the two teams, making this confrontation even more unpredictable and interesting.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Sanfrecce Hiroshima (3-4-2-1): Osako - Shiotani, Araki, Sasaki - Nakano, Kawamura, Notsuda, Higashi - Mitsuta, Kato - Pieros Sotiriou.
  • Gangwon (4-4-2): Gwang-jeong - Song, Kim, Lee, Yun - Hwang, Kim, Aliong, Yang - Yago, Gabriel.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite Gangwon's fighting spirit, Sanfrecce Hiroshima is the clear favorite at home. Experience, player quality, and the home stadium factor should be decisive.

  • Main Prediction: Sanfrecce Hiroshima to Win. The Japanese club is more stable and stronger on their home turf.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Matches between Japanese and Korean teams often turn into tactical battles with a minimum of scoring chances.

Join us for the live broadcast of an intriguing group stage match in the AFC Champions League Elite, as South Korea's FC Seoul hosts Chinese club Chengdu Rongcheng. This is a battle between two ambitious teams representing some of the strongest leagues in Asia.

Kick-off: November 4, 2025, 10:00 UTC (13:00 MSK) Stadium: Seoul World Cup Stadium, Seoul Competition: AFC Champions League Elite

FC Seoul vs Chengdu Rongcheng: Match Preview

FC Seoul, one of the giants of Korean football, enters the match as the favorite, thanks to their vast experience in international competitions and home-field advantage. For the capital club, a victory in this match is a crucial step toward advancing from the group. Chengdu Rongcheng, which has become a leading force in the Chinese Super League, is making its debut in the elite tournament and will be looking to prove its worth. The visitors, led by experienced Korean coach Seo Jung-won, will not be an easy opponent.

Team Form and Analysis

FC Seoul (South Korea)

The team is known for its technical and fast-paced football, with an emphasis on ball control. At home, with the support of their fans, FC Seoul plays particularly aggressively. The team's standout player is English star midfielder Jesse Lingard, on whom much of the attacking creativity depends. The main task for the hosts will be to break down the organized defense of the Chinese club.

Chengdu Rongcheng (China)

The Chinese club, under the guidance of a Korean specialist, relies on tactical discipline and solid defensive play. The team knows how to grind out results and is dangerous on the counter-attack. In an away match against the favorite, Chengdu Rongcheng is likely to adopt a cautious approach, aiming to deny their opponent space and capitalize on their chances from set-pieces.

Head-to-Head Statistics

This will be the first official meeting between the two teams, which adds extra intrigue to the match. The clash of Korean and Chinese football styles always results in a tense battle.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • FC Seoul (4-2-3-1): Baek Jong-beom - Choi Jun, Kwon Wan-kyu, Sulaka, Lee Tae-seok - Ki Sung-yueng, Paločević - Kang Seong-jin, Lingard, Lim Sang-hyub - Iljutcenko.
  • Chengdu Rongcheng (3-4-3): Zhang Yan - Lestienne, Windass, Yang Yiming - Tang Xin, Gan Chao, Zhou Dingyang, Tang Miao - Rômulo, Felipe, Elkeson.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite Chengdu's debutant status, the experience of their Korean coach and their overall organization make them a dangerous opponent. However, FC Seoul is the clear favorite at home.

  • Main Prediction: FC Seoul to Win. Experience and home-field advantage should be the deciding factors in favor of the Korean club.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Chengdu will play defensively, and Seoul may find it difficult to break down their packed defense.

Buriram United vs Shanghai Port: Match Preview

Buriram United, the dominant force in Thai football, enters the match as a 'dark horse.' The 'Thunder Castle' is known for being tough to beat at home, where the hot and humid climate often poses a problem for visiting teams. Shanghai Port, boasting a star-studded lineup including the legendary Oscar, is the favorite, but an away trip to Thailand is never an easy task.

Team Form and Analysis

Buriram United (Thailand)

The Thai champions rely on their fast and technical players, as well as cohesive team play. At home, Buriram plays very aggressively and will try to impose a high tempo on their opponents from the first minute. The main task for the hosts will be to neutralize Shanghai's star foreign players and capitalize on set-pieces.

Shanghai Port (China)

The Chinese giants have one of the most powerful squads in Asia. The team focuses on ball possession and the individual skill of its leaders, such as Oscar and Wu Lei. However, Shanghai often lacks consistency in away matches in the Champions League, where they have to adapt to different styles of play and difficult climatic conditions.

Head-to-Head Statistics

Recent meetings between these teams have been dominated by the Chinese club, which has typically secured victories due to the higher quality of its players. However, Buriram has always put up a strong fight on their home turf.

Brazil U17 vs Honduras U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the FIFA U-17 World Cup group stage match, where one of the main tournament favorites, Brazil, takes on Honduras. This is a classic David vs. Goliath clash, with Brazil holding a total advantage in class.

Kick-off: November 4, 2025, 12:30 UTC (15:30 MSK) Stadium: (To be confirmed by tournament organizers) Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

Brazil U17 vs Honduras U17: Match Preview

The Brazilian national team is traditionally one of the main contenders to win any youth tournament. The 'Seleção' enters the match as the undisputed favorite and will be looking to secure a convincing, high-scoring victory to put themselves in a comfortable position in the group. The Honduras team, representing the CONCACAF region, will try to cause an upset, but their main task will be to withstand the pressure from Brazil's star-studded attack and try not to concede too many goals.

Team Form and Analysis

Brazil U17

The young 'magicians of the ball' are famous for their incredible technique, speed, and attacking potential. The team always features several future stars of world football. The Brazilians will dominate from the first minute, controlling the ball and applying constant pressure on the opponent's goal. In their previous head-to-head match at the 2017 World Cup, Brazil comfortably defeated Honduras 3-0.

Honduras U17

The team from Central America relies on physical strength, dedication, and fast counter-attacks. Against a formidable opponent like Brazil, Honduras is likely to adopt a deep defensive 'bus-parking' tactic, hoping for rare chances from set-pieces.

Head-to-Head Statistics

The last meeting between the teams at the U-17 World Cup in 2017 ended in a confident 3-0 victory for Brazil. This result clearly demonstrates the difference in class between the two teams.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Brazil U17 (4-2-3-1): Felipe; Lima, da Silva, Martins, Henrique; Moscardo, Guilherme; Estevão, Dudu, Rayan; Endrick.
  • Honduras U17 (5-4-1): Valdez; Argueta, Vasquez, Castillo, Flores, Nuñez; Medina, Martinez, Alvarez, Osorio; Rocha.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

The difference in preparation, talent, and experience between the two teams is too vast to expect an upset. Brazil should win comfortably.

  • Main Prediction: Brazil to Win with a (-2.5) Handicap. The 'Seleção' regularly thrashes weaker opponents in the group stages of youth World Cups, as was the case in their 2017 head-to-head meeting (3-0).
  • Goals Prediction: Honduras Individual Total Under 0.5. It will be extremely difficult for Honduras to break down Brazil's organized defense.

Germany U17 vs Colombia U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this opening group stage match of the FIFA U-17 World Cup, where the reigning champions, Germany, take on Colombia. This is an intriguing clash between European organization and South American flair.

Kick-off: November 4, 2025, 14:45 UTC (17:45 MSK) Stadium: Aspire Zone - Pitch 2, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

Germany U17 vs Colombia U17: Match Preview

For Germany, this match is the first step in defending the title they won at the last tournament. Colombia, on the other hand, returns to the world stage after missing the previous two editions and is determined to make a statement. The Germans are considered favorites not only in this match but for the entire tournament, while Colombia, the finalist of the South American qualifiers, is ready to cause an upset.

Team Form and Analysis

Germany U17

The team, led by coach Marc-Patrick Meister, enters the tournament as the defending champions. The squad features standout players like Eintracht Frankfurt forward Alexander Staff, a top scorer in the qualifiers, and the talented Bayern Munich player Wisdom Mike. In a recent friendly, the Germans defeated Canada 2-1, demonstrating their readiness for the tournament. Germany will rely on organized play, high pressing, and clinical finishing.

Colombia U17

'Los Cafeteros,' coached by Freddy Hurtado, return to the World Cup with ambitious plans. The team reached the final of the South American U-17 Championship, where they only lost to Brazil on penalties. Their attack is led by Santiago Londoño, who scored 5 goals in the qualifying tournament. The Colombians are traditionally strong with their technique, speed, and individual skill. They will try to impose their style on the opponent and capitalize on counter-attacking opportunities.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Germany U17 (4-3-3): Trippel; Domnic, Hawighorst, Vali Fard, Turay; Kaba, Mensah, Ley; Mike, Staff, Prenaj.
  • Colombia U17 (4-2-3-1): Mendoza; Macias, Herazo, Garcia, Zapata; Orozco, Mora; Florez, Quiñones, Sevillano; Londoño.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Germany is the favorite due to their champion status, experience, and player quality. However, the Colombian team is capable of putting up a strong fight. In their last two head-to-head meetings, Germany has never lost (one win, one draw).

  • Main Prediction: Germany to Win. The class and organization of the German team should be the deciding factors.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Both teams have potent attacks, and as it's the first game of the tournament, we can expect open football and goals. A 2-1 scoreline is a probable outcome.

Indonesia U17 vs Zambia U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the FIFA U-17 World Cup group stage match in Qatar, featuring Indonesia against Zambia. Both teams have been drawn into a tough Group H alongside Brazil and Honduras, making this head-to-head encounter crucial for their tournament aspirations.

Kick-off: November 4, 2025, 15:45 UTC (18:45 MSK) Stadium: Aspire Zone - Pitch 7, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

Indonesia U17 vs Zambia U17: Match Preview

This will be Indonesia's second consecutive FIFA U-17 World Cup appearance, following their debut in the 2023 tournament. The team, led by coach Nova Arianto, is determined to prove that their participation is no fluke. Zambia, on the other hand, are making their absolute debut in the tournament. The 'Young Chipolopolo' qualified for the World Cup by reaching the quarter-finals of the U-17 Africa Cup of Nations and are eager to make a name for themselves on the global stage. This match will be the first-ever meeting between these two nations at the U-17 level.

Team Form and Analysis

Indonesia U17

The 'Young Garudas' have been preparing seriously for the tournament, playing a series of friendly matches in Dubai. The team are two-time ASEAN U-16 champions (2018, 2022) and rely on their technical and speedy players. Key figures in the squad include midfielders Evandra Florasta and Muhamad Zahaby Gholy, as well as forward Fadly Alberto. The Indonesians will aim to control the game through possession and quick attacks.

Zambia U17

The Zambian national team is participating in the FIFA U-17 World Cup for the first time in their history. The team qualified for the tournament by reaching the quarter-finals of the U-17 Africa Cup of Nations. In preparation for the World Cup, Zambia played several friendlies, including a confident 3-1 victory over their Mexican counterparts. Players to watch include members of the COSAFA U-17 Championship-winning team, such as Robert 'Sugar Sugar' Banda and Mike Mutale. The team is known for its good physical conditioning and athleticism.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Indonesia U17 (4-3-3): Rendy Razzaqu; Dafa Zaidan, Putu Panji, Mathew Baker, Fabio Azkairawan; Evandra Florasta, Nazriel Alfaro, Ilham Romadhona; Fadly Alberto, Mierza Firjatullah, Zahaby Gholy.
  • Zambia U17 (4-4-2): Rogers Simumba; Jonathan Kalimina, Saviour Mwansa, James Sibeene, Andrew Mwape; Mapalo Simute, Bongani Ndhlovu, Nkotami Chimwemwe, Kelvin Mulenga Chipelu; Robert Banda, Abel Salim Nyirongo.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Both teams are considered dark horses in their group, and the outcome of their direct encounter is difficult to predict. Indonesia has a slight edge in terms of World Cup experience, while Zambia boasts more athletic players.

  • Main Prediction: Draw. Given the importance of the match and the relatively equal strength of the teams, a draw seems the most likely outcome. Both teams will prioritize not losing.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. A debut match in such a major tournament is always associated with high pressure. The teams are likely to play cautiously, which will probably result in a low number of goals.

Al Sadd vs Al-Ahli: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of one of the most anticipated matches of the AFC Champions League Elite group stage, as Qatar's Al Sadd hosts Saudi Arabia's Al-Ahli. This is a battle between two titans of Asian football, whose squads are filled with world-class stars.

Kick-off: November 4, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK) Stadium: Jassim Bin Hamad Stadium, Doha Competition: AFC Champions League Elite

Al Sadd vs Al-Ahli: Match Preview

This 'Gulf Derby' promises to be a true highlight of the tournament. Both teams come into the match in excellent form. Al Sadd has won their last six matches in a row, while Al-Ahli has won their last five. Al Sadd, one of Qatar's strongest clubs, is relying on its home advantage. Al-Ahli, reinforced by stars from top European leagues, is one of the main favorites to win the tournament.

Team Form and Analysis

Al Sadd (Qatar)

The Qatari giants are known for their combination play and attacking style. The team has won 12 of its last 15 home matches, confirming their strength on their own turf. Al Sadd scores regularly, but their defense is not always flawless, which could be a problem against Al-Ahli's star-studded attack.

Al-Ahli (Saudi Arabia)

The Jeddah-based club has one of the most formidable attacks in Asia. The trio of Mahrez, Saint-Maximin, and Firmino is capable of breaking down any defense. The team relies on the individual skill of its foreign players. Al-Ahli has won their last three away matches in a row and will be looking to continue this streak.

Head-to-Head Statistics

In the last 10 head-to-head meetings, Al Sadd has the advantage with 5 wins, 3 losses, and 2 draws. However, recent encounters between these teams have been very high-scoring: 6 of the last 7 matches have had over 2.5 goals.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Al Sadd (4-2-3-1): Barsham; Pedro Miguel, Khoukhi, Salman, Hassan; Uribe, Guilherme; Afif, Cazorla, Al-Haydos; Bounedjah.
  • Al-Ahli (4-3-3): Mendy; Majrashi, Ibañez, Demiral, Al-Ammar; Kessié, Al-Majhad, Veiga; Mahrez, Firmino, Saint-Maximin.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

This is a match where the attack of both teams looks significantly stronger than their defense. An open game with plenty of scoring chances is expected.

  • Main Prediction: Both Teams to Score & Over 2.5 Goals. Both teams are in excellent form, score a lot of goals, and 6 of their last 7 head-to-head meetings were high-scoring.
  • Score Prediction: Draw. The teams are roughly equal in strength; Al Sadd is strong at home, but Al-Ahli has a powerful squad. A high-scoring 2-2 draw seems the most likely outcome.

Sepahan vs Ahal: Match Preview

Sepahan, one of the giants of Iranian football, enters the match as the undisputed favorite. The team is traditionally very strong on their home turf. Sepahan (Iran)

The Isfahan-based club is known for its organized play and powerful attack. At home, Sepahan will aim to dominate from the first minute, applying constant pressure on the opponent's goal. The difference in quality between the Iranian and Turkmen leagues is a key factor, and the motivation to avenge the past defeat will be immense.

Ahal (Turkmenistan)

The champions of Turkmenistan regularly participate in Asian club competitions but rarely achieve success against top-tier opponents, especially away from home. The team relies on dedication and set-pieces. The main task for Ahal will be to withstand the pressure and try not to concede too many goals by playing a deep defensive game.

Head-to-Head Statistics

The only head-to-head meeting between the teams took place in April 2022 on neutral ground in Saudi Arabia and ended in a sensational 2-1 victory for Ahal. This result will undoubtedly add motivation for Sepahan, who will be eager to prove their superiority on their home turf.

Predicted Starting Lineups

The difference in class and the home-field advantage make Sepahan the absolute favorite. The motivation to avenge their only defeat in the history of this rivalry will be an additional incentive.

Eintracht, who finished third in the Bundesliga last season, are currently mid-table and have won just one of their last seven matches in all competitions. The previous meeting between the teams in the 2022/23 knockout stage ended in a convincing victory for Napoli (2-0 and 3-0).

Team Form and Analysis

Napoli

The Italian champions are known for their formidable home form, having lost just one of their last 18 Champions League matches at their stadium. After the defeat to PSV, Conte's side has somewhat stabilized, securing Serie A wins against Inter and Lecce, and drawing with Como. However, the team faces significant injury problems: key players Kevin De Bruyne, Romelu Lukaku, and goalkeeper Alex Meret will miss the match due to injury, while Lorenzo Lucca is suspended.

Eintracht Frankfurt

Dino Toppmöller's team is going through a difficult period. The Eagles' defense is a major concern, having conceded 25 goals in their last eight games. In the last Bundesliga round, Eintracht failed to beat one of the underdogs, Heidenheim (1-1). In addition to defensive issues, they have also suffered a blow in attack with the injury of important forward Can Uzun.

Slavia Praha vs Arsenal: Match Preview

Arsenal approaches this match in magnificent form, boasting a perfect record after three Champions League rounds - three wins without conceding a single goal. Mikel Arteta's side is also confidently leading the English Premier League. Slavia, on the other hand, is yet to secure a victory in this season's competition, with two draws and one loss. Despite this, the Czech club remains unbeaten in their domestic league. The head-to-head history is firmly in Arsenal's favor: in four previous meetings, the Londoners have two wins and two draws, including a resounding 4-0 victory on their last visit to Prague in 2021.

Team Form and Analysis

Slavia Praha

Jindřich Trpišovský's team is facing a significant injury crisis, with key players including captain Jan Bořil, Tomáš Holeš, Ivan Schranz, and Igoh Ogbu all sidelined. Despite this, Slavia is known for its resilience at home, having failed to score in only one of their last 27 European home games. In the Champions League, the Prague side's results have been modest, earning two points from matches against Bodø/Glimt and Atalanta, but losing to Inter Milan.

Arsenal

The Gunners are in peak form, having won nine consecutive matches in all competitions and keeping clean sheets in their last seven. However, Mikel Arteta also has his share of injury headaches. Gabriel Martinelli, Martin Ødegaard, Kai Havertz, Gabriel Jesus, and Viktor Gyökeres will all miss the match. Al Ittihad vs Al Sharjah: Match Preview

Welcome to the live broadcast of the main event of the fourth round of the UEFA Champions League, where the reigning champions, Paris Saint-Germain, host Bayern München at their Parc des Princes stadium. This match brings together the two leaders of the league phase, both with perfect records, and promises to be a true highlight of the European football evening.

Kick-off: November 4, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Parc des Princes, Paris Competition: UEFA Champions League

PSG vs Bayern München: Match Preview

Both teams approach this head-to-head clash with perfect records in the Champions League, having secured three wins in their opening three matches. PSG currently tops the table, ahead of Bayern only on goals scored. Bayern, under Vincent Kompany, are in phenomenal form, having won all 15 of their matches since the start of the season across all competitions. The Parisians, despite some inconsistency in the French league and personnel issues, also lead Ligue 1. The last meeting between the sides was in the summer of 2025 at the FIFA Club World Cup, which ended in a 2-0 victory for PSG; however, in their last four Champions League encounters, Bayern have consistently come out on top.

Team Form and Analysis

PSG

Luis Enrique's side, despite being the defending European champions, has faced some difficulties at the start of the season due to injuries to key players. In their last Ligue 1 outing, the Parisians needed a stoppage-time winner to beat Nice 1-0, and before that, they drew 1-1 with Lorient. In the Champions League, however, PSG has been far more convincing, thrashing Bayer Leverkusen 7-2 in the last round. Significant absences for this match include suspended central defender Illia Zabarnyi and injured attacking midfielder Désiré Doué.

Bayern München

The Munich side is in unprecedented form, riding a 15-match winning streak. Kompany's team has been dominant both in the Bundesliga and the Champions League, where they defeated Club Brugge 4-0 in their last fixture. Bayern's attack looks formidable, with Harry Kane in sensational form, having scored 22 goals this season. Despite the long-term absence of key players like Jamal Musiala and Alphonso Davies due to injury, the Munich machine has been operating flawlessly.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • PSG (4-3-3): Chevalier; Hakimi, Marquinhos, Pacho, Mendes; Vitinha, Zaïre-Emery, Neves; Kvaratskhelia, Dembélé, Barcola.
  • Bayern München (4-2-3-1): Neuer; Laimer, Tah, Upamecano, Guerreiro; Kimmich, Pavlović; Olise, Gnabry, Díaz; Kane.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although bookmakers slightly favor PSG due to their home advantage, Bayern's phenomenal form makes them a strong contender for the win. Historically, Bayern has a good record against PSG in the Champions League.

  • Main Prediction: Bayern München to Win. The incredible winning streak and the sheer power of the Munich attack should be the deciding factors against a Parisian side facing tactical and personnel issues.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Both teams possess star-studded forward lines and have been high-scoring in the Champions League, which suggests an open and goal-rich match.

Welcome to the live broadcast of an intriguing UEFA Champions League match, where Norwegian champions Bodø/Glimt host French Ligue 1 side Monaco at their Aspmyra Stadion. This is the first-ever meeting between these teams, and it holds immense importance for both in their fight for a spot in the knockout stages.

Kick-off: November 4, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Aspmyra Stadion, Bodø Competition: UEFA Champions League

Bodø/Glimt vs Monaco: Match Preview

Both teams are yet to secure a victory in this season's Champions League, each having drawn twice in their first three matches. Bodø/Glimt, making their debut in the league phase, sensationally took points from Slavia Prague (2-2) and Tottenham (2-2), but lost away to Galatasaray (1-3). Monaco also had a rocky start, suffering a heavy 4-1 defeat to Club Brugge before drawing with Manchester City (2-2) and Tottenham (0-0). The Norwegians are renowned for their powerful performances on their home artificial pitch in the Arctic Circle, which will be a significant challenge for the Monegasques.

Team Form and Analysis

Bodø/Glimt

Kjetil Knutsen's team is at its physical limit, balancing their Champions League campaign with a title race in the Norwegian league, which has only three rounds left. A recent 3-1 loss to Vålerenga in the Eliteserien ended a long unbeaten streak and could be a sign of fatigue. Nevertheless, Bodø/Glimt is unbeaten in their last nine home games across all competitions, winning seven of them. The team has some injury concerns, with Ulrik Saltnes, Haitam Aleesami, and Ola Brynhildsen sidelined.

Monaco

The Monegasques are going through a difficult period of instability and a severe injury crisis. In their last Ligue 1 match, the team lost 1-0 to Paris FC. The injury list is extensive, with key players like Denis Zakaria, Eric Dier, Paul Pogba, and Vanderson set to miss out. In the Champions League, Monaco are winless in their last six matches. However, a positive note is the return of Russian midfielder Aleksandr Golovin, who is one of the team's leaders.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Bodø/Glimt (4-3-3): Haikin; Sjøvold, Bjørtuft, Nielsen, Bjørkan; Evjen, Berg, Fet; Hauge, Høgh, Auklend.
  • Monaco (3-4-2-1): Kohn; Kehrer, Salisu, Caio Henrique; Diatta, Teze, Coulibaly, Ouattara; Akliouche, Golovin; Balogun.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Monaco appears stronger on paper, the harsh weather conditions, artificial turf, and incredible home support make Bodø/Glimt the favorites in the eyes of some bookmakers. Monaco is facing significant personnel and performance issues, especially in away matches.

  • Main Prediction: Bodø/Glimt to Win. The Norwegian champions are desperate for their first victory and will use all their advantages – a difficult trip for the opponent and a powerful home performance – to achieve success.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Bodø/Glimt has scored in all three of their Champions League matches, but has also conceded in each one. Given the attacking potential of both teams and their defensive vulnerabilities, a high-scoring game is expected.

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the UEFA Champions League league phase, where London's Tottenham Hotspur hosts the Danish champions, FC København, at their home stadium. This is a crucial match for Spurs in their fight for a playoff spot, while for the Danes, it's a chance to snatch some points against a top-tier club.

Tottenham Hotspur vs København: Match Preview

Tottenham enters this match sitting 17th in the Champions League table, which is outside the playoff qualification zone. Ange Postecoglou's side lost to Monaco (0-1) in the last round and are in desperate need of a win to improve their standing. København, on the other hand, is one of the tournament's underdogs, with only one point after three rounds. The Danes have lost their last two matches against Atalanta (0-2) and Inter Milan (0-1). The only previous encounter between the teams took place in the 2007 UEFA Cup and ended in a 1-0 victory for Tottenham.

Team Form and Analysis

Tottenham Hotspur

Spurs have shown inconsistent results recently. After the defeat to Monaco, Postecoglou's team failed to beat Brentford in the Premier League (0-0). The Australian manager's signature attacking style doesn't always yield results, especially against well-organized teams. Nevertheless, Tottenham is traditionally strong at home and will look to dominate the game. The team has some injury concerns, with forward Richarlison and defender Micky van de Ven potentially missing the match.

København

Jacob Neestrup's team is confidently leading the Danish league but is facing expected difficulties in the Champions League. The Lions rely on an organized defense and quick counter-attacks. Despite their underdog status, København is capable of causing problems for any opponent, as they proved in last season's competition by drawing with Manchester City. Key players to watch for the Danes are the young Swedish talent Roony Bardghji and the experienced midfielder Viktor Claesson.

Tottenham is the clear favorite in this matchup. The difference in class, the home-field advantage, and extreme motivation should secure a comfortable victory for the London side. København will try to resist with a tight defense, but containing Spurs' attacking line will be extremely difficult.

  • Main Prediction: Tottenham to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. Postecoglou's team needs a big win to improve their goal difference and will go all out to achieve it.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Tottenham's attacking style creates a lot of goal-scoring opportunities, and even if København manages to score, the hosts are likely to respond with several goals of their own.

Join us for the live broadcast of one of European football's most anticipated fixtures, as Liverpool hosts Real Madrid at the legendary Anfield. This classic Champions League encounter promises to be intense, especially with the return of former local hero Xabi Alonso as the manager of Los Blancos and Trent Alexander-Arnold in a Real Madrid shirt.

Kick-off: November 4, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Anfield, Liverpool Competition: UEFA Champions League

Liverpool vs Real Madrid: Match Preview

Liverpool comes into the match after a much-needed 2-0 Premier League victory over Aston Villa, which ended a run of six losses in seven matches across all competitions. Arne Slot's side is looking to stabilize their results and improve their position in the Champions League, where they sit 10th after three games. Real Madrid, in contrast, are in scintillating form. Under Xabi Alonso, the Royal club has won 13 of their 14 games this season, lead La Liga, and have a perfect record in the Champions League after three matchdays. Historically, Real Madrid has the upper hand in head-to-head meetings, winning 7 of their 12 encounters, but the last match at Anfield in November 2024 ended in a 2-0 victory for Liverpool.

Team Form and Analysis

Liverpool

Arne Slot's team is navigating a difficult period, marked by numerous injuries and inconsistent performances. The win against Aston Villa should boost their confidence, but defensive frailties remain a concern. The Reds have significant personnel issues: first-choice goalkeeper Alisson Becker, along with key outfield players Alexander Isak and Jeremie Frimpong, will miss the match. Curtis Jones's participation is also in doubt.

Real Madrid

Under Alonso's guidance, Real Madrid is playing powerful and confident football. The team has won their last six games in all competitions, including a 4-0 thrashing of Valencia and a 2-1 'El Clásico' victory over Barcelona. However, Madrid also has significant squad problems, particularly in defense. Dani Carvajal, Antonio Rüdiger, and David Alaba are all out with injuries. Young Argentine Franco Mastantuono is also sidelined.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite the Anfield factor, Real Madrid appears to be the favorite in this clash. Xabi Alonso's team is in excellent form and has shown consistency, which cannot be said for Liverpool, who have been plagued by injuries and a dip in performance.

  • Main Prediction: Real Madrid to Win. Their superb current form, a potent attack led by Mbappé and Vinicius, and Alonso's tactical flexibility should be the deciding factors.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Both teams have defensive issues due to injuries but possess immense attacking potential. An open game with plenty of scoring opportunities is expected.

Kick-off: November 4, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Riyadh Air Metropolitano, Madrid Competition: UEFA Champions League

Atlético Madrid vs Union Saint-Gilloise: Match Preview

Atlético comes into this match in good form domestically, where Diego Simeone's team has won a series of games and lost only one of their last nine matches in all competitions. However, their Champions League campaign has been inconsistent so far: after three rounds, they have only three points, earned in a home game against Eintracht Frankfurt, alongside two away defeats to Liverpool and Arsenal. Team Form and Analysis

Atlético Madrid

Diego Simeone's side is traditionally strong at home. Atlético is unbeaten in their last 11 matches at the Metropolitano, securing 10 wins. In the last La Liga round, the Madrid side convincingly beat Sevilla 3-0. Despite this, the team's performance in the Champions League has lacked consistency. The participation of midfielder Pablo Barrios is in doubt due to a muscle problem.

Union Saint-Gilloise

The Belgian champions are leading their domestic league, demonstrating high scoring form. Since a change of coach (David Hubert replacing Sébastien Pocognoli), the team has won four out of five matches. However, in the Champions League, the debutants have faced stiff competition, resulting in two consecutive heavy defeats. Union will be without injured forward Mohammed Fuseini for this match.

Predicted Starting Lineups

  • Atlético Madrid (3-5-2): Oblak; Giménez, Witsel, Hermoso; Llorente, De Paul, Koke, Saúl, Lino; Griezmann, Morata.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Atlético Madrid is the clear favorite for this encounter. Their vast experience in the Champions League, powerful performances at home, and superior class should be the key factors. Union is an ambitious debutant, but the team may lack the experience to compete with such a formidable opponent away from home.

  • Main Prediction: Atlético Madrid to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. Considering Union's struggles in their recent Champions League matches and Atlético's fortress-like home form, a comfortable win for the hosts seems highly likely.

Juventus vs Sporting CP: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of a crucial UEFA Champions League match, as Juventus hosts Sporting CP at their Allianz Stadium. For the Old Lady, this will be their European debut under new coach Luciano Spalletti and a chance to secure their first win in this season's competition.

Kick-off: November 4, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Allianz Stadium, Turin Competition: UEFA Champions League

Juventus vs Sporting CP: Match Preview

Juventus comes into this match in a difficult position. The team has yet to win in the current Champions League campaign, having collected only two points from three matches. However, the appointment of Luciano Spalletti, who replaced Igor Tudor, and the victory in the last Serie A round against Cremonese (2-1) should give the team a confidence boost. Sporting, on the other hand, has had a more successful start to the tournament with 6 points to their name. The Portuguese side is in excellent form, having won five consecutive matches in all competitions. The head-to-head history favors Juventus; the Italian club is unbeaten in their last four meetings with Sporting (two wins, two draws).

Team Form and Analysis

Juventus

The Bianconeri are undergoing a transition with the arrival of Spalletti. The team is trying to find its rhythm, which is reflected in their inconsistent results. In the Champions League, Juve drew with Borussia Dortmund (4-4) and Villarreal (2-2), and lost to Real Madrid (0-1). The Turin side has significant injury problems, especially in defense: Gleison Bremer, Lloyd Kelly, and Juan Cabal will miss the match due to injuries, as will goalkeeper Carlo Pinsoglio and striker Arkadiusz Milik. All hopes in attack rest on Dušan Vlahović, who has been involved in 11 goals (8 goals, 3 assists) since his Champions League debut.

Sporting CP

The Lisbon Lions approach the match in high spirits. The team is performing confidently both domestically, where they sit second in the league, and in Europe. Sporting boasts a potent attack, having scored 7 goals in three Champions League matches, with 4 of those goals coming from substitutes, the best record in the competition. However, the Portuguese club has a historically poor record against Italian teams: Sporting has never won in Italy, with a record of 14 losses and 5 draws in 19 matches.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Juventus (3-5-2): Di Gregorio; Kalulu, Rugani, Koopmeiners; Cambiaso, McKennie, Locatelli, Thuram, Kostić; Yıldız, Vlahović.
  • Sporting CP (4-2-3-1): Rui Silva; Vagiannidis, Diomande, Inácio, Araújo; João Simões, Hjulmand; Catamo, Trincão, Gonçalves; Ioannidis.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite the current form of the teams, Juventus is considered the favorite for the match. The home-field advantage, a new coach, and a favorable head-to-head record should help the Italians. Sporting is in excellent form, but their inability to perform well in Italy could be a decisive factor.

  • Main Prediction: Juventus to Win. Spalletti's team needs their first Champions League victory to stay in contention, and a home match against a historically favorable opponent is the best opportunity for it.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. The last three head-to-head meetings between these teams have seen fewer than three goals scored. Given the importance of the match and Juventus's attacking struggles, a high-scoring affair is not expected.
